title: From solar cells to memristors: halide perovskites as a platform for neuromorphic electronics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2145-2228
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01222H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Natalia Yantara, Xuechao Xing, Divyam Sharma, Darrell Jun Jie Tay, Shibi Varku, Nripan Mathews
Halide perovskites, with tunable ionic-electronic properties and strong photoresponse, are apt for optoelectronic memristors. The path to neuromorphic applications- addressing the challenges in materials, devices, and systems, is detailed.
